0022600131.text: The Trail Blazers (2-0, on a two-game winning streak) are visiting the Lakers (3-0, on a three-game streak) for Portland's third game of the season. Portland sits 2nd in the Northwest, 1 game back, and 4th in the West, while Los Angeles leads the Pacific and is 3rd in the West. Portland will be without Chris Youngblood (ankle soreness) and Shaedon Sharpe (knee surgery), and Scoot Henderson is day-to-day with ankle soreness and a game-time decision, while Los Angeles is missing Adou Thiero (knee inflammation). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but Portland won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, including a 132-116 win in Portland on January 17, 2026.
